standard-dialogue.player: Hello there. What is this place?

standard-dialogue.npc: This is our Sacred Grove. It is a place dear to all tortugans, but I'm afraid I can't allow you to enter.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-enter-th.npc: Stop, human! You don't have permission to go in there!

standard-dialogue-after-the-red-reef.npc: Hello, human. You may enter the Sacred Grove and cut wood from the camphor trees any time you wish.
